# Profitable Agent Stack

> Cost-first directory of AI GTM tools ranked by use-case fit, published price and user sentiment, with estimated monthly stack costs by GTM team size. Prices checked 2026-11-02; verify with vendors. Not advice.

## Key pages
- [Stacks by GTM team size](https://profitableagentstack.com/stages/)
- [Solo founder (1 GTM person)](https://profitableagentstack.com/stages/solo-founder.html): est. $41/mo stack
- [Small GTM team (2–5 GTM people)](https://profitableagentstack.com/stages/small-gtm-team.html): est. $106/mo stack
- [Early scaling (6–15 GTM people)](https://profitableagentstack.com/stages/early-scaling.html): est. $818/mo stack
- [Scaling (16–40 GTM people)](https://profitableagentstack.com/stages/scaling.html): est. $1,948/mo stack
- [Large / multi-team (40+ GTM people)](https://profitableagentstack.com/stages/large-multi-team.html): est. at least $7,151/mo stack

## Tools
- Apollo (List building & lead data; stages: solo, small, early, scaling, large): Free Starter plan (no time limit; Apollo's FAQ calls it for 'exploring or very light usage'); Basic $49, Professional $79, Organization $119 per seat/mo billed annually (Organization: 3-seat minimum, SSO listed in plan table); Custom plan for SSO, advanced security and custom volumes via sales. Value score: 100. Source: https://www.apollo.io/pricing
- Clay (Enrichment & verification; stages: small, early, scaling, large): Free plan (500 actions/mo); Launch $167/mo (annual-billing view; $185 monthly), Growth $446/mo (annual-billing view; $495 monthly), both usage-based on actions and data credits; Enterprise custom (SSO/SAML, SCIM, RBAC, IP allowlists, custom DPA). Value score: 100. Source: https://www.clay.com/pricing
- Google Search Console (SEO & content; stages: solo, small, early, scaling, large): Free (Google describes it as a free service). Value score: 100. Source: https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/9128668
- Framer (Landing pages & websites; stages: solo, small, early): Free $0 (Framer domain); Basic $10/mo, Pro $30/mo (yearly-billing view; monthly-billing price not verified). Value score: 100. Source: https://www.framer.com/pricing
- beehiiv (Newsletters; stages: solo, small, early, scaling, large): Free forever (1,000-subscriber view); Lite $49/mo yearly billing; Pro $95/mo yearly billing. Value score: 100. Source: https://www.beehiiv.com/pricing
- Instantly (Outbound email / sequencing; stages: solo, small, early, scaling, large): Outreach: Growth $47/mo (5,000 emails), Hypergrowth $97/mo (125,000 emails, 25,000 contacts), Light Speed $358/mo (500,000 emails); monthly billing view. Credits plans (e.g. Growth Credits $47/mo) are separate. Value score: 94. Source: https://instantly.ai/pricing
- Smartlead (Outbound email / sequencing; stages: solo, small, early): Base from $39/mo (pricing page also lists Pro, Smart, Prime tiers). Value score: 88. Source: https://www.smartlead.ai/pricing
- Exa (List building & lead data; stages: solo, small, early): Free $10 credits/mo; Search from $4 per 1k requests (usage-based). Value score: 88. Source: https://exa.ai/pricing
- Hunter (Enrichment & verification; stages: solo, small, early, scaling, large): Free (50 credits); Starter $49/mo monthly ($34 annual); Growth $149 ($104); Scale $299 ($209). Value score: 88. Source: https://hunter.io/pricing
- FullEnrich (Enrichment & verification; stages: small, early, scaling, large): Free trial; Pro 15K credits $720/mo; other credit tiers on page. Value score: 88. Source: https://fullenrich.com/pricing
- Waalaxy (LinkedIn outreach; stages: solo, small, early): €19, €49, €69 per user/mo; 14-day free trial (EUR). Value score: 88. Source: https://www.waalaxy.com/pricing
- HeyGen (Design & video; stages: solo, small, early, scaling, large): Free $0; Creator $29/mo; Pro $49/mo; Business $149/mo. Value score: 88. Source: https://www.heygen.com/pricing
- RB2B (Signals, intent & analytics; stages: solo, small, early, scaling): Free $0; Starter $79/mo; Pro from $149; Pro+ from $199. Value score: 88. Source: https://www.rb2b.com/pricing
- PostHog (Signals, intent & analytics; stages: solo, small, early, scaling, large): Free monthly allowance (e.g. 1M analytics events), then usage-based. Value score: 88. Source: https://posthog.com/pricing
- Ahrefs Free (SEO & content; stages: solo, small, early): Free: site audit and SEO metrics for websites you verify (formerly Ahrefs Webmaster Tools); paid plans not captured. Value score: 88. Source: https://ahrefs.com/webmaster-tools
- Buffer (Social scheduling; stages: solo, small, early, scaling, large): Free: up to 3 channels; Essentials $5/mo per channel and Team $10/mo per channel (billed-yearly view: $60/yr and $120/yr per channel); vendor says annual billing saves 20%, monthly price not captured. Value score: 88. Source: https://buffer.com/pricing
- Typefully (Social scheduling; stages: solo, small, early): Free plan available; paid plan prices not captured. Value score: 88. Source: https://typefully.com/pricing
- Carrd (Landing pages & websites; stages: solo, small, early): Free account; Pro Lite $9/yr, Pro Standard $19/yr (custom domain), up to $69/yr for 50 sites. Value score: 88. Source: https://carrd.com/pro
- Webflow (Landing pages & websites; stages: small, early, scaling, large): Free (webflow.io domain); site plans Basic $15/mo billed yearly, Premium (CMS, new name on the page) $25/mo billed yearly. Value score: 88. Source: https://webflow.com/pricing
- Kit (Newsletters; stages: solo, small, early): Free $0 (up to 10,000 subscribers); Creator $33/mo billed yearly ($390/yr); Pro $66/mo billed yearly, shown at $50/mo for the first year as a limited-time offer. Value score: 88. Source: https://kit.com/pricing
- Descript (Design & video; stages: solo, small, early): Free $0; Hobbyist $16/mo yearly ($24 monthly); Creator $24 yearly ($35 monthly); Business $50 yearly ($65 monthly), per person. Value score: 88. Source: https://www.descript.com/pricing
- CapCut (Design & video; stages: solo, small, early): Free USD 0; paid plan prices not captured. Value score: 88. Source: https://www.capcut.com/pricing
- Circle (Community; stages: small, early, scaling, large): Professional $89/mo, Business $199/mo, Scale $419/mo (billing period not verified); 14-day free trial, no free plan listed. Value score: 88. Source: https://circle.so/pricing
- Google Analytics (Web analytics; stages: solo, small, early, scaling, large): Free of charge (Google). Value score: 88. Source: https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/
- HeyReach (LinkedIn outreach; stages: small, early, scaling, large): Growth $79/sender/mo; Agency $999/mo (25 senders); Unlimited $2,999/mo. Value score: 83. Source: https://www.heyreach.io/pricing
- Salesforge (Outbound email / sequencing; stages: solo, small, early): Page title says 'Starting at $48/mo'; plan subscriptions shown at $40 and $80/mo billed monthly. Value score: 81. Source: https://www.salesforge.ai/pricing
- Plausible (Web analytics; stages: solo, small, early): Starter $9/mo (up to 10k pageviews; monthly vs yearly billing view not verified), Growth $14/mo, Business $19/mo; 30-day free trial, no free plan. Value score: 74. Source: https://plausible.io/
- Reply.io (Outbound email / sequencing; stages: small, early, scaling, large): Email volume tiers 'starts from' $59 monthly (lower with annual); LinkedIn add-on $69/mo/acct; higher tiers vary. Value score: 72. Source: https://reply.io/pricing/
- lemlist (Outbound email / sequencing; stages: small, early, scaling, large): Email $69/mo monthly ($55 annual), 50,000 emails/mo; Multichannel $109/mo ($87 annual). Value score: 65. Source: https://www.lemlist.com/pricing
- Expandi (LinkedIn outreach; stages: solo, small, early): $99/mo monthly ($79 annual), 7-day free trial. Value score: 65. Source: https://expandi.io/pricing/
- Postiz (Social scheduling; stages: solo, small, early, scaling, large): Standard $29/mo, Team $39, Pro $49, Ultimate $99. Value score: 65. Source: https://postiz.com/pricing
- Common Room (Signals, intent & analytics; stages: large): Essential $2,500/mo billed annually (5 seats). Value score: 65. Source: https://www.commonroom.io/pricing
- Surfer (SEO & content; stages: small, early, scaling, large): Discovery $49/mo, AI Visibility $82/mo, Standard $99/mo, Pro $182/mo, Peace of Mind $299/mo (page lists "USD per month", billed yearly). Value score: 65. Source: https://surfer.ai/pricing/
- Fathom Analytics (Web analytics; stages: solo, small, early, scaling, large): From $15/mo (up to 100,000 monthly pageviews); 7-day free trial. Value score: 65. Source: https://usefathom.com/pricing
- Woodpecker (Outbound email / sequencing; stages: solo, small, early): Price not captured automatically — see vendor page. Value score: None. Source: https://woodpecker.co/pricing/

Value score: None. Source: https://clearout.io/pricing/

## Stacks by GTM team size (estimates)
### Solo founder (1 GTM person): $40.58/mo + €19 Waalaxy
Assumptions: 1 GTM person, 1 LinkedIn account, light volume. Hunter's free plan (50 credits/mo) caps how many new emails you can find; move up when you outgrow it. Monthly billing, entry tiers; Carrd is priced yearly ÷ 12.
- List building & lead data: Apollo, Free Starter plan, $0 — Highest value score for list building (free, fit 5/5). Exa is a free alternative if you prefer search-style prospecting. Free-plan limits change, so check them.
- Enrichment & verification: Hunter, Free plan (50 credits), $0 — Free email finding and verification is enough for light hand-built lists.
- Outbound email / sequencing: Smartlead, Base, 1 workspace, $39 — Lowest published entry price for outbound email in our list. Instantly scores higher on value (94 vs 88) but costs $8 more; revisit at 2–5 people.
- LinkedIn outreach: Waalaxy, 1 user × €19 (EUR, not converted), $0 — Cheapest listed LinkedIn tool and the best value score in its category. Per user, billed in euros.
- Landing pages & websites: Carrd, Pro Standard, $19/yr ÷ 12, $1.58 — Cheapest custom-domain landing page in our list; $19/yr is the yearly price on its Pro page.
- Newsletters: beehiiv, Free plan, $0 — Highest value score; free until you monetize. Kit is the free alternative (free up to 10,000 subscribers).
- Web analytics: Google Analytics, Free, $0 — Free and good enough for basic traffic and source tracking at this size.
### Small GTM team (2–5 GTM people): $106/mo + €38 Waalaxy (2 users)
Assumptions: 3 GTM people, 2 LinkedIn users, ~5,000 emails/mo, monthly billing, entry tiers. Waalaxy is priced per user in euros and not converted.
- List building & lead data: Apollo, Free Starter plan, $0 — Highest value score for list building; free. Check current free-plan limits.
- Enrichment & verification: Hunter, Starter, $49 — Hunter shares one credit pool across unlimited team members (vendor help center), so adding people does not add seats.
- Outbound email / sequencing: Instantly, Outreach Growth, $47 — Highest value score for outbound (94). Unlimited mailboxes on one plan; its lead credits are not added because Hunter covers enrichment.
- LinkedIn outreach: Waalaxy, 2 users × €19 (EUR, not converted), $0 — Light LinkedIn volume at the lowest per-user price. Move to HeyReach when you run many senders.
- SEO & content: Google Search Console, Free, $0 — Free first-party search data. Paid content tools wait until you publish weekly.
- Social scheduling: Buffer, Free (up to 3 channels), $0 — Free for up to 3 channels; best value score in its category (tied with Typefully).
- Landing pages & websites: Framer, Basic (yearly-billing view), $10 — Multi-page site with your own domain for content/SEO. Carrd is cheaper but single-page.
- Newsletters: beehiiv, Free plan, $0 — Free until you monetize.
- Web analytics: Google Analytics, Free, $0 — Free web analytics; add product/funnel analytics later.
- Signals, intent & analytics: RB2B, Free plan, $0 — Optional, and only if warm intros plus outbound are already booking meetings: free website-visitor identification to prioritize follow-up.
### Early scaling (6–15 GTM people): $818/mo 
Assumptions: 10 GTM people, 5 LinkedIn senders, ~25,000 emails/mo (inside Instantly's 125,000/mo Hypergrowth tier), monthly billing. Surfer is its yearly-billed view; Framer is its yearly-billing view. PostHog counted at its free allowance (usage-based beyond it).
- List building & lead data: Apollo, Free Starter plan, $0 — Free is for 'exploring or very light usage' per Apollo; we count $0 for light list pulls, but 6-15 people will likely outgrow it. Basic is $49/seat/mo billed annually (not counted). 28% of Apollo's 9,858 G2 reviewers are mid-market (51-1,000 employees).
- Enrichment & verification: Hunter, Growth, $149 — Clearer enrichment: more credits shared across unlimited team members, and verification before sending.
- Outbound email / sequencing: Instantly, Outreach Hypergrowth (125,000 emails/mo), $97 — Full outbound volume on one plan; highest value score for outbound.
- LinkedIn outreach: HeyReach, Growth $79 × 5 senders, $395 — Built for many senders (fit 5/5). Waalaxy is cheaper per seat if you only need light LinkedIn volume.
- Signals, intent & analytics: RB2B, Starter, $79 — Signals become useful at this volume: identifies site visitors to feed outbound.
- SEO & content: Google Search Console, Free, $0 — Free first-party data on which queries bring visitors.
- SEO & content: Surfer, Discovery, billed yearly, $49 — Content as a system: optimization is a separate job from tracking. Discovery is its lowest listed tier.
- Social scheduling: Postiz, Team, $39 — Team scheduling beyond Buffer’s free 3-channel limit.
- Landing pages & websites: Framer, Basic (yearly-billing view), $10 — Design-led site with custom domain; lowest paid tier.
- Newsletters: beehiiv, Free plan, $0 — Free until you monetize (Lite is $49/mo, yearly-billing view).
- Web analytics: Google Analytics, Free, $0 — Website traffic and sources.
- Product & funnel analytics: PostHog, Free allowance, $0 — Real product and funnel analytics (a separate job from visitor identification); usage-based beyond the free allowance.
### Scaling (16–40 GTM people): $1,948/mo 
Assumptions: 25 GTM people, 10 LinkedIn senders, high email volume (125,000/mo), monthly list prices except Apollo (10 prospecting seats, billed annually); Webflow and Surfer are yearly-billed views. RB2B Pro is a 'from' price. PostHog counted at its free allowance (usage-based beyond it).
- List building & lead data: Apollo, Basic, 10 seats × $49 (billed annually), $490 — Free is for 'exploring or very light usage' per Apollo, so we count Basic for the 10 people who prospect ($49/seat/mo billed annually, credits pooled across the team). 28% of Apollo's 9,858 G2 reviewers are mid-market (51-1,000 employees), roughly 2,800 reviewers. Professional ($79) adds waterfall enrichment, which overlaps Hunter, so it is not counted. Confirm seats and credits with the vendor.
- Enrichment & verification: Hunter, Scale, $299 — Largest listed tier; unlimited team members share one credit pool, so no per-seat cost. G2 shows 31.9% of Hunter's 659 reviewers are mid-market (about 210) versus 24.8% of Clay's 234 (about 58), so Clay is not clearly the mid-market pick. Step up to Clay Growth ($495/mo monthly list) when RevOps needs CRM auto-sync, phone numbers and signals; the Large stack uses Clay.
- Outbound email / sequencing: Instantly, Outreach Hypergrowth (125,000 emails/mo), $97 — Cost-first pick at this volume. Test its admin and role controls in the trial; Reply.io is the step-up when you need org-level roles (see Large).
- LinkedIn outreach: HeyReach, Growth $79 × 10 senders, $790 — Multi-seat: its help center documents Admin and Member roles with per-feature permissions.
- Signals, intent & analytics: RB2B, Pro (from $149), $149 — Signals are core at this size. RB2B Pro is the lowest-cost listed paid tier; Common Room ($2,500/mo) is the step-up for community and multi-channel signals.
- SEO & content: Google Search Console, Free, $0 — Free first-party data.
- SEO & content: Surfer, Discovery, billed yearly, $49 — Content optimization, a separate job from tracking.
- Social scheduling: Postiz, Pro, $49 — Social scheduling across a marketing team.
- Landing pages & websites: Webflow, Premium (billed yearly), $25 — CMS-capable site for a content team; lowest CMS tier on its pricing page.
- Newsletters: beehiiv, Free plan, $0 — Free until you monetize; Pro is $95/mo (yearly-billing view).
- Web analytics: Google Analytics, Free, $0 — Website traffic and sources.
- Product & funnel analytics: PostHog, Free allowance, $0 — Queryable product/funnel analytics. Pipeline and revenue reporting belong in your CRM, which this directory does not cover.
### Large / multi-team (40+ GTM people): at least $7,151/mo (list-price floor)
Assumptions: 40+ GTM people across teams, 25 of them prospecting in Apollo (Organization, billed annually, 3-seat minimum), ~25 LinkedIn senders (HeyReach Agency tier), monthly list prices except Apollo and Common Room (billed annually, Common Room 5 seats). Clay is its Growth monthly list price; its Enterprise tier is custom. Reply.io is a 'from' price: its higher tiers vary and need a quote. Enterprise tiers, SSO and security documents are quote-based. This total is a floor, not a quote.
- List building & lead data: Apollo, Organization, 25 seats × $119 (billed annually, 3-seat min), $2975 — Not the free Starter: 40+ people need SSO and admin controls, which Apollo sells on Organization ($119/seat/mo billed annually) and its Custom plan. Size evidence: of 9,858 G2 reviews, 28% come from mid-market and 5% from enterprise companies (roughly 2,800 and 450 reviewers), Apollo publishes a 130-rep customer story (Superside), and it lists SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 in its trust center. Seats assumed: 25 of your 40+ people prospect. ZoomInfo has a larger enterprise review share (26%) but no public price: quote both.
- Enrichment & verification: Clay, Growth from $495/mo; Enterprise is custom, $495 — Clay's Enterprise tier lists SSO/SAML, SCIM, role-based access, IP allowlists and a custom DPA, it states SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, and its case studies include Intercom, Verkada and Rippling. Hunter's public pages list a custom enterprise volume plan but no SSO. Caveat: Clay's G2 reviewers skew small (74% under 51 employees, 1% enterprise), with a learning curve and fast credit use as top complaints, so pilot with credit budgets. $495 is Growth's monthly list price; SSO and RBAC need the Enterprise quote.
- Outbound email / sequencing: Reply.io, Email, from $59, $59 — Documents organization, multi-team and single-team roles and permissions in its help center, and says it is SOC 2 certified. Pricing beyond the entry tier needs a quote. Instantly ($97 at 125,000 emails/mo) is cheaper if your security team accepts its attestation.
- LinkedIn outreach: HeyReach, Agency (25 senders), $999 — $999/mo for 25 senders beats $79 × 25. Roles are documented, but we found no SOC 2 claim and its DPA says SSO is not currently supported: confirm with security.
- Signals, intent & analytics: Common Room, Essential (billed annually, 5 seats), $2500 — Vendor security page lists a SOC 2 Type 2 report, GDPR and CCPA, SSO/SAML/SCIM and role-based access.
- SEO & content: Google Search Console, Free, $0 — Free first-party data.
- SEO & content: Surfer, Discovery, billed yearly, $49 — Content optimization; check seat limits for multiple teams.
- Social scheduling: Postiz, Pro, $49 — Social scheduling across teams.
- Landing pages & websites: Webflow, Premium (billed yearly), $25 — CMS-capable site; lowest CMS tier. Enterprise plans are quote-based.
- Web analytics: Google Analytics, Free, $0 — Website traffic and sources.
- Product & funnel analytics: PostHog, Free allowance, $0 — Product/funnel analytics, usage-based beyond the free allowance.
- AI SDR / agentic SDR: Artisan, Contact sales — optional, not counted, $0 — Only after a measured pilot: contact sales is fine at this size when the need is real. 11x and Qualified are the other listed options.

## Methodology
Value = 50% fit (editorial) + 30% cost + 20% sentiment; sentiment not yet verified so fit/cost reweighted 62.5/37.5.

## Disclaimer
Profitable Agent Stack is for general information only, provided "as is" without warranties. Prices, plans, features and review data change often and may be inaccurate or out of date (last checked 2026-11-02); always verify with the vendor. Cost estimates and scores are editorial estimates, not advice. Nothing here is professional, legal or financial advice. Trademarks belong to their owners; listing is not endorsement. Some links may be affiliate or sponsored — see our Disclosure.
